description: This file defines the GuzzleHttp Middleware class, providing static methods to create various middleware functions for handling HTTP requests and responses, such as cookies, error handling, request history, logging, redirects, retries, and request/response mapping.

classes.name: Middleware
classes.description: A final class providing static methods to generate HTTP middleware functions for handling cookies, errors, history, logging, redirects, retries, and request/response transformations.

methods.name: cookies
methods.description: Creates middleware to add cookies to requests using a CookieJarInterface.

methods.name: httpErrors
methods.description: Creates middleware to throw exceptions for 4xx or 5xx responses when 'http_errors' option is true.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Creates middleware to record request and response data into a provided container.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Creates middleware to invoke callbacks before and after sending a request.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Creates middleware to handle HTTP redirects.

methods.name: retry
methods.description: Creates middleware to retry requests based on a decider function, with optional delay.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Creates middleware to log requests, responses, and errors using a specified logger and formatter.

methods.name: prepareBody
methods.description: Creates middleware to set default headers like content-type, content-length, and transfer-encoding.

methods.name: mapRequest
methods.description: Creates middleware to transform requests via a mapping function.

methods.name: mapResponse
methods.description: Creates middleware to transform responses via a mapping function.
